- changelog.d/6469-deploy-activate-credential-free-checks.md:Line 6 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  PROBLEM: The release note incorrectly states that when commit protection or pre-deploy checks fail, the system guides the operator through a manual deployment fallback.
  WHY: CLAUDE.md §24.C and the updated deploy-activate.md command instructions explicitly require the step to be BLOCKED and prohibit a manual deployment workaround. Telling operators a fallback exists when the system blocks them leads to user confusion and audit/compliance failure.
- changelog.d/6469-deploy-activate-credential-free-checks.md:Lines 1-4 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  PROBLEM: The PR includes two changelog fragments (6435-prompt-audit-claude-config.md and 6469-deploy-activate-credential-free-checks.md), violating the one-fragment-per-PR rule in CLAUDE.md §20.A.
  WHY: The release assembler will process both fragments, producing two overlapping release entries for this PR, which violates changelog hygiene rules and can cause assembly failures or content duplication.
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- changelog.d/6469-deploy-activate-credential-free-checks.md:Line 6 — "if commit protection cannot be verified, the command will guide you through the step rather than deploying itself" | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  PROBLEM: The release note describes a "guide you through the step" path when commit protection cannot be verified, which contradicts the actual command behavior.
  WHY: Operators reading the changelog will believe a manual deployment path exists after a failed safety check, but the command will BLOCK and refuse to emit any deploy command (including operator-run ones). The command text in both `.claude/commands/deploy-activate.md:96` and `workflow-templates/.claude/commands/deploy-activate.md:105` states: "If protection, pinning, worktree verification or pre-deploy checks fail or cannot be confirmed, mark the Cloudflare step BLOCKED in the activation log and give only a corrective verification step. Never emit a Worker deploy command, including one for the operator to run, until the protected default-branch SHA, clean pinned worktree and pre-deploy checks are verified".
- changelog.d/6435-prompt-audit-claude-config.md and changelog.d/6469-deploy-activate-credential-free-checks.md:Both fragments are present in the PR (lines 1-18 and 1-6 respectively) | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  PROBLEM: This PR adds two changelog fragments, violating `CLAUDE.md` §20.A which requires "Add exactly one fragment when the PR changes observable behaviour" and "One fragment per PR. Never reuse another PR's filename — the unique path is the whole point."
  WHY: The release assembler will fold both fragments into `CHANGELOG.md`, producing two release entries for the same PR that both describe the same Cloudflare deployment gate. This clutters the changelog with duplicate information and confuses downstream consumers reading the release history.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
